answer: Each challenge is derived only after a participant commits, by hashing its task parameters with a future drand quicknet pulse. Threshold BLS makes the pulse publicly verifiable yet unpredictable before enough shares arrive, so sybil swarms cannot precompute answers or farm valid challenges offline. Commit-reveal binds each submission to its beacon-derived challenge and limits selective rerolling; even a sonnet prompt at an inlet can share a thread, but its challenge nonce remains distinct.
